newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia tenders for bank to sell spa businesses.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia tenders for bank to sell spa businesses.

text.p: Tunisia has launched an international tender to select a merchant bank to assist it in selling a spa business as part of its privatisation programme, official said on Thursday.

They said the business includes an hotel, sports complex and rehabilitation centre in the spa station of Jebel Oust, southern of Tunis, and a spa station in Menzel Bourguiba, in northwestern Tunisia. They are owned by the state's spa body Office du Thermalisme Tunisien.
Deadline for submiting offers was set for June 25.

Bankers said it was the first time Tunisia had formally tendered to select a merchant bank for its privatisation programme, but that it was already in the process of directly selecting a merchant bank to assist it in privatising a cement factory.
Officials said the tender was the second part of the privatisation of the spa sector. Last year, Tunisia sold off three state-owned hotels and one establishment for 1.5 million dinars.
The three hotels and the establishment are located in the coastal spa resort of Korbous, 30 km (18 miles) south east of Tunis, and were managed by the state's Office du Thermalisme. ($=1.0981 dinar)
